4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11: 
12:   // Set canvas to full width/height of its container or a fixed size.
13:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
14:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 200;
15: 
16:   // Player (glowing dot)
17:   const player = {
18:     x: 50,
19:     y: height - 20,
20:     radius: 10,
21:     vy: 0,
22:     jumpStrength: -12,
23:     color: '#0ff',
24:     onGround: true,
25:   };
26: 
27:   const gravity = 0.6;
28:   const speed = 4; // world scroll speed
29:   let obstacles = [];
30:   let frames = 0;
31:   let score = 0;
32:   let running = true;
33: 
34:   function spawnObstacle() {
35:     const w = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
36:     const h = 20 + Math.random() * 40;
37:     obstacles.push({
38:       x: width,
39:       y: height - h,
40:       w,
41:       h,
42:       color: '#f0f',
43:     });
44:   }
45: 
46:   function update() {
47:     if (!running) return;
48:     frames++;
49:     // increase score each frame (~60 per second)
50:     if (frames % 60 === 0) score++;
51: 
52:     // player physics
53:     player.vy += gravity;
54:     player.y += player.vy;
55:     if (player.y >= height - player.radius) {
56:       player.y = height - player.radius;
57:       player.vy = 0;
58:       player.onGround = true;
59:     }
60: 
61:     // move obstacles left
62:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= speed);
63:     // remove off‑screen obstacles
64:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
65: 
66:     // spawn new obstacles periodically
67:     if (frames % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
68: 
69:     // collision detection (dot vs rectangle)
70:     for (const o of obstacles) {
71:       const withinX = player.x + player.radius > o.x && player.x - player.radius < o.x + o.w;
72:       const withinY = player.y + player.radius > o.y && player.y - player.radius < o.y + o.h;
73:       if (withinX && withinY) {
74:         running = false;
75:         break;
76:       }
77:     }
78:   }
79: 
80:   function draw() {
81:     // clear
82:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
83:     // background
84:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
85:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
86:     // player
87:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
88:     ctx.beginPath();
89:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
90:     ctx.fill();
91:     // obstacles
92:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
93:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
94:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
95:     });
96:     // score
97:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
98:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
99:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
100:     // game over overlay
101:     if (!running) {
102:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
103:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
104:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f88';
105:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
106:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
107:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 10);
108:       ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
109:       ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, width / 2, height / 2 + 30);
110:     }
111:   }
